name: mla_query_heads_n_heads96_head_dim576
description: out[t, h, :] = q[t, h mod n_heads, :] for every h < out_heads: the query's heads, then its first ones again, out_heads heads in all, the bytes unchanged (vLLM's q.repeat(1, reps, 1)[:, :out_heads]).

head_dim.description: Width of a head's row (vLLM's kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim).

q.description: The decode query, one byte an element (vLLM's static fp8 query under an fp8 KV cache).

out.description: The query with its heads tiled to out_heads.

sources.content:
"""The MLA decode query's heads tiled to the decode kernel's head count, in FlyDSL for gfx950:
out[t, h, :] = q[t, h mod H, :] for h < M, the bytes as they are.

q is (tokens, H, D) contiguous, one byte an element, D a multiple of 16; out (tokens, M, D) contiguous, M > H. One
thread per 16 bytes of q: it loads them once and stores them at head h, h + H, h + 2 H, ... while below M. Loads and
stores go through buffer descriptors bound to the tensors' sizes, so the threads past the last 16 bytes read zero
and store nothing, and so do the copies past M. Compiled per (H, M, D); the token count is an argument.
"""

import functools

import flydsl.compiler as flyc
import flydsl.expr as fx
import torch
from flydsl._mlir import ir
from flydsl.expr import range_constexpr, rocdl
from flydsl.expr.typing import T

THREADS = 256
PACK = 16  # bytes a thread moves


@functools.cache
def _build(H, M, D):
    PPH = D // PACK  # packs a head
    PPT = H * PPH  # packs a token of q
    R = -(-M // H)  # copies of a head, the last one partial

    @flyc.kernel(known_block_size=[THREADS, 1, 1])
    def tile_heads_kernel(
        q_t, o_t, n_packs: fx.Int32, q_bytes: fx.Int32, o_bytes: fx.Int32
    ):
        g = fx.Int32(fx.block_idx.x) * THREADS + fx.thread_idx.x
        ok = g < n_packs
        t = g // PPT
        p = g % PPT
        h = p // PPH
        c = p % PPH
        zi = fx.Int32(0).ir_value()
        aux = ir.IntegerAttr.get(T.i32, 0)
        q_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(
            rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(fx.get_iter(q_t), num_records_bytes=q_bytes)
        )
        o_rs = rocdl.get_buffer_rsrc(
            rocdl.make_buffer_ptr(fx.get_iter(o_t), num_records_bytes=o_bytes)
        )
        v = rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_load(
            T.i32x4,
            q_rs,
            fx.Int32(ok.select(g * PACK, q_bytes)).ir_value(),
            zi,
            aux=aux,
        )
        for j in range_constexpr(R):
            head = h + j * H
            off = (ok & (head < M)).select(((t * M + head) * PPH + c) * PACK, o_bytes)
            rocdl.raw_ptr_buffer_store(v, o_rs, fx.Int32(off).ir_value(), zi, aux=aux)

    @flyc.jit
    def launch(
        q_t,
        o_t,
        n_packs: fx.Int32,
        q_bytes: fx.Int32,
        o_bytes: fx.Int32,
        n_wg: fx.Int32,
        stream: fx.Stream,
    ):
        tile_heads_kernel(q_t, o_t, n_packs, q_bytes, o_bytes).launch(
            grid=(n_wg, 1, 1), block=(THREADS, 1, 1), stream=stream
        )

    return launch


def run(*, q, out_heads, out_dtype, out):
    n_tokens, n_heads, head_dim = q.shape
    assert (
        q.element_size() == 1
        and head_dim % PACK == 0
        and q.is_contiguous()
        and out.is_contiguous()
    )
    assert (
        out.shape == (n_tokens, out_heads, head_dim)
        and out_heads > n_heads
        and out.numel() < 2**31
    )
    n_packs = q.numel() // PACK
    _build(n_heads, out_heads, head_dim)(
        q.view(torch.int32).view(-1),
        out.view(torch.int32).view(-1),
        n_packs,
        q.numel(),
        out.numel(),
        -(-n_packs // THREADS),
        fx.Stream(torch.cuda.current_stream(q.device)),
    )
